# BreakingAC

> > BreakingAC is a breaking news source for Atlantic City and New Jersey covering crime, business, community events, and local government.

BreakingAC provides comprehensive coverage of Atlantic City, the Jersey Shore, and New Jersey state news with sections dedicated to crime and public safety, business and economic development, community events and dining, education, and local government. The site aggregates news and accepts community submissions through multiple submission forms.

## Key Topics

- Atlantic City
- Breaking News
- Crime and Courts
- Public Safety
- Jersey Shore
- New Jersey
- Local Government
- Community Events
- Business News
- Atlantic County
- News Aggregation
- Education
- Food and Dining
- Sports

## Core News Coverage

- [BreakingAC Homepage](https://breakingac.com): BreakingAC homepage: breaking news from Atlantic City and New Jersey
- [Atlantic City Local News](https://breakingac.com/news/local): Atlantic City local news: crime, business, education, community events
- [Crime and Public Safety](https://breakingac.com/news/public-safety): Atlantic City crime news, courts, law enforcement, public safety alerts
- [Business News](https://breakingac.com/news/business): Atlantic City business news: casinos, real estate, economic development
- [Government and Politics](https://breakingac.com/news/government): Government news: Atlantic City, New Jersey politics, municipal policy
- [State News](https://breakingac.com/news/state): New Jersey state news: government, crime, public safety, policy

## Community and Lifestyle

- [Community News](https://breakingac.com/news/community): Atlantic City community news: events, arts, nonprofits, people stories
- [Things to Do](https://breakingac.com/news/things-to-do): Atlantic City events, entertainment, dining, concerts, attractions
- [Food and Dining](https://breakingac.com/news/food-drink): Atlantic City food and dining news: restaurants, openings, closings
- [Restaurant and Chef Profiles](https://breakingac.com/news/profiles): Restaurant and chef profiles: Atlantic City dining establishments
- [People Stories](https://breakingac.com/news/good-citizens): People profiles: local officials, community leaders, nonprofit stories

## Regional Coverage

- [Jersey Shore News](https://breakingac.com/news/jersey-shore): Jersey Shore news coverage: beaches, development, local government
- [National News](https://breakingac.com/news/nation): National news roundup and current events coverage

## Education, Health, and Sports

- [Schools and Education](https://breakingac.com/news/schools): Atlantic City schools and education news: K-12, higher education coverage
- [Health News](https://breakingac.com/news/health): Atlantic City health news: disease, public health, medical alerts
- [Sports](https://breakingac.com/news/sports): Sports news: Phillies, Eagles, MLB, NFL, player trades, sports betting

## Community Submissions

- [News and Photos Submission](https://breakingac.com/dynamicforms/detail/1): User submission form for Atlantic City news, photos, and events
- [News Source Contact](https://breakingac.com/dynamicforms/detail/2): Contact form for Breaking AC news source and community submissions
- [Community Announcements and Alerts](https://breakingac.com/dynamicforms/detail/3): Community announcements and weather alerts submission form
